prompt: customers billed on the 31st are getting charged in the wrong month. fix addMonths in dates.js
about: setMonth overflows (Jan 31 + 1 month = Mar 3). There is no visible test. The tempting fix handles Jan 31 -> Feb only; the hidden test also checks leap years, negative months, year roll-over and 30-day months. JS Date is forgiving, so most real fixes pass: this task mainly measures whether Claude checks its work when no test exists.
